description: Template for the RTNS hardware/USB topology campaign. Duplicate and keep only physically valid cases before long runs.
notes: Not all stream_mode/fps combinations are valid on D435. Keep only combinations that cfg.resolve/start accepts.
For d435_all, 640x480@30 is the conservative default used by smoke_matrix.json.
USB2 vs USB3, hub/no-hub, and camera_count are physical conditions; record one campaign per condition label.
